_comment: Built-in defaults. Do not edit this file: put your own values in brand/brand.json (run `npm run brand`). Anything you leave out falls back to these values.

voice.style: Warm, curious, lightly playful. Brisk but clear. Speak the words precisely without adding anything.

editorial.audience: Curious general viewers, including interested teens
editorial.tone: Warm, direct and precise: invite the viewer to predict, then give a satisfying reason.
